source_quotes: Cheltenham is a suburb in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia, 18 km south-east of Melbourne's Central Business District, located within the Cities of Bayside and Kingston local government areas. Cheltenham recorded a population of 23,992 at the 2021 census.

Much residential development occurred in the second half of the 1940s after World War II ended and this growth continued into the 1980s. ... Cheltenham also has a large industrial area on the eastern edge and a smaller area at the far western edge.
A significant feature in Cheltenham is Westfield Southland, a major shopping centre which opened in 1968.
